import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
import sqlite3
from src.repository import initialize, list_contacts
from src.api import handle_import
from src.service import import_contacts

def fresh():
    c = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    initialize(c)
    return c

def rejects(c, f):
    before = list_contacts(c)
    try:
        f()
    except ValueError:
        assert list_contacts(c) == before
        assert not c.in_transaction
        return
    raise AssertionError("expected ValueError")

c = fresh()
assert handle_import(c, {"contacts": []}) == {"inserted": 0, "updated": 0}
assert handle_import(c, {"contacts": [{"email": " A@B.com ", "name": " Al "}]}) == {"inserted": 1, "updated": 0}
assert list_contacts(c) == [("a@b.com", "Al")]
r = import_contacts(c, [{"email": "a@b.com", "name": "Al"}, {"email": "x@y", "name": "X"}])
assert r == {"inserted": 1, "updated": 1}
assert import_contacts(c, [{"email": "A@B.com", "name": "New"}]) == {"inserted": 0, "updated": 1}
assert list_contacts(c) == [("a@b.com", "New"), ("x@y", "X")]

good = {"email": "ok@ok", "name": "Ok"}
bad_rows = [
    "str", None, {"email": "a@b"}, {"email": "a@b", "name": "n", "x": 1},
    {"email": "a@@b", "name": "n"}, {"email": "ab", "name": "n"}, {"email": "@b", "name": "n"},
    {"email": "a@", "name": "n"}, {"email": "a b@c", "name": "n"}, {"email": "a@b", "name": "  "},
    {"email": 1, "name": "n"}, {"email": "a@b", "name": None},
    {"email": "OK@ok", "name": "dup"},
]
for b in bad_rows:
    rejects(c, lambda: import_contacts(c, [good, b]))
for p in [None, [], {}, {"contacts": None}, {"contacts": {}}, {"contacts": [], "x": 1}]:
    rejects(c, lambda: handle_import(c, p))

# database failure mid-batch rolls back
c.execute("CREATE TRIGGER t BEFORE INSERT ON contacts WHEN NEW.email = 'boom@x' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'boom'); END")
c.commit()
before = list_contacts(c)
try:
    import_contacts(c, [{"email": "a@b.com", "name": "Changed"}, {"email": "n@n", "name": "N"}, {"email": "boom@x", "name": "B"}])
    raise AssertionError
except sqlite3.Error:
    pass
assert list_contacts(c) == before and not c.in_transaction

# autocommit-mode connection also atomic
c2 = sqlite3.connect(":memory:", isolation_level=None)
initialize(c2)
c2.execute("CREATE TRIGGER t BEFORE INSERT ON contacts WHEN NEW.email = 'boom@x' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'boom'); END")
try:
    import_contacts(c2, [{"email": "n@n", "name": "N"}, {"email": "boom@x", "name": "B"}])
    raise AssertionError
except sqlite3.Error:
    pass
assert list_contacts(c2) == []
print("ok")
